integrity: The proof is analytic; finite exact-arithmetic and numerical checks are corroborative. Literature comparisons distinguish the new explicit parameterization and critical amplitude from previously published existence, threshold and convergence results.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the positive two-periodic scalar boundary-law sector only. It does not classify arbitrary nonperiodic Gibbs measures or different compatibility graphs. An equivalent weakly indexed parameterization under different variables cannot be excluded.
title: Exact all-order two-periodic branch for the countable-state hard-core tree model
